TEXT: The next day.
Before the preparation for the closing ceremony, everyone took their belongings from their desks and lockers.
Obviously, Manami and I did as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...Here we go!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's a lot of stuff; you had that much?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yours is almost the same anyway～
The textbooks and dictionaries I always forgot to take home, my old gross gym clothes, all stuffed in a pile of paper bags.
My hands were completely full of things I didn't even want to look at.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's wrong? Not feeling well?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: That's not it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Is it because your bags are heavy? I can take one for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: No, it's fine. You're the one who looks like you're about to drop one!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm fine! Thanks to my superb balance!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yeah...
Something is definitely bringing her down. Is she concerned about what happened yesterday?
Well, no sense in worrying about it. I'll have to cheer her up!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I know. Manami, you're sad because we can't hold hands because of the bags, right?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Manami?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ah, no. Don't worry about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't worry about what?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Well, what you said. Holding hands... Kissing...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: "Those" things.
What... happened?
Until now, I was thinking that she wasn't feeling well, but that's not it.
She was putting on a smile.
Does that mean... that I only "thought" I knew how she really felt...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Because it's not something Kyou-chan wants.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Manami?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: The truth is, I was thinking, "He might want all of that."

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I guess I may have gotten carried away.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hehe. Do you remember? When I was little, I really loved to play make-believe.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I was always the princess or the explorer!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: So... With Kyou-chan, we may have pretended being a couple... you know, make-believe...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Manami, that's--

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I'm done with playing make-believe. Yeah, that's enough.
Wrong. You're wrong, Manami...
You don't... you don't have to look at me like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: What's wrong, Kyou-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't hate it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's not it...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hm...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, ever since I became your boyfriend, you may have caused me some troubles but... Not even once did I dislike being with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Rea...lly?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, you were acting differently from your usual self. So it just got me a bit confused.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Usual self?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, so there's no problem. Sorry if I made you worry.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I... see. Yes. That's right, it might be why.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: What you're probably saying is you want to be with the "regular" me, rather than the... "different" me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I don't have any particular talent. But there's something I'm proud of.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Something... you're proud of?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: It's the fact that I've always been with Kyou-chan. That's the only time where I can say that I surpass everyone else. Ah, Kirino-chan doesn't count

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: though～

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, there's nothing like that between her and I...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I just selfishly assumed that Kyou-chan might be happy if he was with me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Manami...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: But it wasn't all fun and games. You always had to tell me to "calm down".

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: But I thought, "Isn't that also part of being happy?". Hehehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: But you know, this happiness... If it's not the "usual" me that is with Kyou-chan, I'll never feel truly happy. I finally understand this.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: It's really obvious, now that I think about it...
At this time, I carelessly forgot- to put my thoughts into action.
I can't even understand my own thoughts and feelings. Yet this girl, Tamura Manami, understands me, Kousaka Kyousuke, completely.
Thanks to Manami's consideration, I was able to overcome the seemingly endless disputes I had with Kirino.
Now that it's come to this, I can't be so stubborn... not anymore. I'm going to reveal my true feelings to Manami.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah... I guess. Manami is Manami but... how do I say this... Recently... you haven't been the Manami I know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Compared to the Manami I know, the current you feels too... I don't know, restless, I guess, when we're together.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, thanks for telling me...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ahah... The old me... I wonder what she was like...
